payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of the SATA-LSTM model against various baseline models, including both syntactic and non-syntactic approaches.

claims.text: The SATA-LSTM model was compared against neural models built on syntactic trees, latent trees, and non-tree models.
The models compared include Latent Syntax Tree-LSTM, Tree-based CNN, Gumbel Tree-LSTM, NSE, Reinforced Self-Attention Network, Residual stacked encoders, and BiLSTM with generalized pooling.
The SATA Tree-LSTM shows competitive performance compared to previous syntactic tree-based models and other neural models.
